svg.title: Serverless (Functions)
svg.desc: Serverless (Functions). Functions start per event, scale out automatically and scale to zero when idle. Step 1, An event starts a function: Nothing runs until an event arrives: the platform cold-starts an instance and runs the handler. Step 2, Warm reuse, then scale out: The next event reuses the warm instance. A burst gets one instance per event, up to a limit. Step 3, State lives outside: Instances keep no state: they use managed services. A failed async event is retried, then parked. Step 4, Scale to zero: Traffic stops and idle instances are reclaimed: zero instances and zero compute cost.

g.text: Nothing runs until an event arrives: the platform cold-starts an instance and runs the handler.
The next event reuses the warm instance. A burst gets one instance per event, up to a limit.
Instances keep no state: they use managed services. A failed async event is retried, then parked.
Traffic stops and idle instances are reclaimed: zero instances and zero compute cost.
cold start: only when no warm instance is free
you pay per request and for how long it runs
warm start: instance reused, cold start skipped
burst: one instance per concurrent event
new instances cold-start in parallel; the warm one answers first
memory and local disk are scratch:
gone when the instance is reclaimed
then parked in the dead-letter queue
idle instances stay warm for a while,
the next event pays a cold start
